text: This report recommends that the name "Habibi Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located south of Innes Avenue extending westerly from Caledonia Road to Gilbert Avenue. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Habibi Lane" for an existing public lane located south of Innes Avenue extending westerly from Caledonia Road to Gilbert Avenue.
